**Job Title: ABM Specialist**

**Location:** Hyderabad / Pune (Hybrid)

**Experience:** 5 – 10 Years

**Role Overview**

This role focuses on strategy and orchestration with hands-on execution. Our performance marketing team builds and runs the ads, and you'll guide their targeting and rationale. Product marketing writes the content, and you'll brief them on what's needed and by when. You'll help ensure the quality and coherence of both the ads and content that go into the program.

This is a role centred on outcomes. Success will be measured primarily by the SQLs and pipeline the program generates.

**What You Will Own**

* Account strategy and execution. Collaborate on which accounts we target, how we tier them, and when an account moves from cold to active.
* Buying committee mapping. Identifying the roles inside each account that matter, C-level tech leaders and decision makers, C-1 influencers and champions, and building a different reach plan for each of them.
* Campaign strategy. Designing and approving every campaign in the program, including channel sequencing, offers, and timing.
* Daily coordination with our SDR/Sales team so every engaged account and every lead gets followed up quickly.
* Briefing performance marketing on targeting, and briefing product marketing on the messaging & battlecards and content the campaigns need.
* Weekly reporting on account engagement, SQLs, and pipeline.
* Other targeted campaigns we decide to run that are not strictly account-based.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Primary: number of SQLs produced by the program, and total pipeline generated.
* Secondary: engagement across target accounts, and how fast engaged accounts get worked.

* 5 to 7 years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 of those running account-based or targeted campaigns into named accounts.
* Experience marketing a B2B SaaS product or IT services.
* You understand the difference between an account, a segment inside an account, and a buying committee, and you can explain how you would reach each one differently.
* Working knowledge of HubSpot or a similar CRM, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and account intent or engagement tools.

**Nice to have**

* Experience marketing to technical buyers such as Engineering, Data and AI, QA/QC, or IT leaders.
* Vertical ABM background in Retail and E-Commerce, Travel & Hospitality, Direct to Consumer Services, Gaming or Healthcare.
* Hands-on with Factors.ai, 6sense, Demandbase, Clay, Hubspot, http://apollo.io or similar.

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
